# stripe_product (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about a Stripe Product.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the product.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the product is currently available for purchase.
- `created` (Number) Time at which the product was created.
- `description` (String) The product's description.
- `images` (List of String) A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to a product.
- `name` (String) The product's name.
- `updated` (Number) Time at which the product was last updated.
